Hymn 119: Come, We That Love the Lord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Robert Lowry

Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 119 titled "Come, We That Love the Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Robert Lowry and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
